text:
elaine: hey @vendor-ops, can we get a short lease for 2 H100s in us-west2 tonight (00:00-06:00 PT) for a latency perf benchmark? need billing code + serials for compliance.
vendor-ops: we can do that — there9s capacity in us-west2 tonight. provisional billing code RED-ENG-BENCH. want me to create a short-lease order now? :white_check_mark:
elaine: yes please, create it and paste the order id here. also i opened a quick terraform PR to add the reserved pool, link below. would appreciate a review. https://git.internal/r/infra/terraform/+/1234
sam: i can review the TF in the morning. quick quota sanity: @devops-bot can you confirm GPU quota in us-west2 for project redwood-infra?
devops-bot: Quota check for project "redwood-infra" in us-west2: H100 quota remaining = 3, H100 in-use = 1. Command (for manual): `gcloud compute accelerators list --filter="zone:us-west2"`
nate: i9ll grab the PR now and run a quick plan. drop any smoke-test commands if you have them.
vendor-ops: created order ID L-98321, short-lease window set. will push serials to secure ticket in ~15m (ticket 51234). short-lease discount applied.
elaine: terraform snippet i added (for context):
```
resource "redwood_gpu_lease" "bench_overnight" {
  name       = "bench-overnight-1742106789"
  region     = "us-west2"
  sku        = "H100"
  count      = 2
  window     = "2025-03-05T07:00:00Z/2025-03-05T13:00:00Z"
  cost_center = "RED-ENG-BENCH"
}
```
sam: tiny nit: prefer hyphens in the resource name — looks good otherwise, will leave a comment on the PR. :+1:
vendor-ops: lease confirmed (L-98321). serials: H100-AX12, H100-AX13 (secure details in ticket 51234). rack IDs included in ticket.
elaine: awesome, thanks! once PR merges i9ll kick off the benchmark and post results here.
